comments.text:
Yes, in India you can take two or more health insurance policies at the same time. There is no restriction by IRDAI on the number of policies a person can hold.


How it works

You must inform both insurers
When buying or claiming, you must disclose the details of your other policy to the insurer.

Cashless claim – only one policy at a time
In a hospital, you can normally use cashless facility with only one insurer first.

Balance claim from the second insurer
If the hospital bill exceeds the first policy’s coverage, you can claim the remaining amount from the second insurer through reimbursement.

No double benefit
You cannot make profit from insurance. The total claim amount cannot exceed the hospital bill.
